question: Abrupt discontinuation of corticosteroids taken for more than 3 weeks can precipitate adrenal crisis; therefore, doses should always be tapered gradually to allow HPA axis recovery.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. The steroid withdrawal rule is clinically critical: any course >3 weeks (or high-dose >1 week) requires a tapering schedule to prevent adrenal insufficiency.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct! Prolonged supraphysiological glucocorticoid use suppresses CRH and ACTH release, causing adrenal atrophy. Abrupt withdrawal can precipitate life-threatening Addisonian crisis.
